title: Montenegrin–Ottoman War (1861–1862)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Montenegrin–Ottoman War (1861–1862)", at revision 1370628630, opens: "The Montenegrin–Ottoman War (1861–1862) was a war between the Principality of Montenegro and the Ottoman Empire that took place between 1861 and 1862. The war ended and Montenegro had to acknowledge Ottoman suzerainty." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16724471, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war between the Principality of Montenegro and the Ottoman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
